
# AltiMath

> AltiMath is a French-language mathematics education website dedicated to helping students in Morocco learn mathematics through structured lessons, summaries, worked examples, corrected exercises and examination preparation.

## About AltiMath

AltiMath publishes educational mathematics resources for Moroccan students. Its content is primarily written in French and covers mathematics topics for middle-school and high-school levels.

The website aims to provide clear explanations, practical examples and exercises with corrections.

## Main Website

- [AltiMath Homepage](https://www.altimath.com/): Main website and access to all educational resources.

## Published Educational Content

- [XML Sitemap](https://www.altimath.com/sitemap.xml): Discover published articles and website pages.
- [Atom Feed](https://www.altimath.com/feeds/posts/default): Discover recent educational publications.
- [RSS Feed](https://www.altimath.com/feeds/posts/default?alt=rss): Access recent mathematics articles and updates.

## Content Topics

- Mathematics lessons and explanations.
- Mathematics summaries and revision resources.
- Worked examples and corrected exercises.
- Mathematics examination preparation.
- Mathematics education for Moroccan middle-school and high-school students.

## Language and Audience

- Main language: French.
- Educational context: Morocco.
- Intended audience: Middle-school and high-school students.
